dbpcm_warehouse.accrual_events.description: Employee accrual-event log for time-off requests and related accrual activity. Event-level records, not an accrual-balance table.
dbpcm_warehouse.accrual_events.grain_note: Event-level accrual log. No reliable exposed row id; do NOT assume uniqueness by employee_code, request_date, earn_code, or status. Granularity is ONE ROW PER DAY of a request (see request_date), so SUM(hours) over a request_date range is exact. Logical analysis grain: one accrual event/day row.
dbpcm_warehouse.accrual_events.primary_key_note: No reliable unique primary key is exposed.

employee_code.description: Employee identifier; canonical join key to employee.

request_date.description: The single day the time off / accrual event is for. Granularity is ONE ROW PER DAY — a multi-day request creates one row per day — so SUM(hours) over a request_date range is exact (no hidden multi-day spans). Use for when the leave/event occurs.

hours.description: hours attached to the accrual event. Do not assume these are approved/taken hours without filtering status.

earn_code.description: Accrual earning code. CLIENT-DEFINED and drifts over time — resolve concepts to codes via resolveValues(earn_code, <concept>), do not hardcode. Interpret with earn_description and the requested period.

earn_description.description: Human-readable description for earn_code. Use with earn_code; either field can be null or historically inconsistent.

status.description: Approval/workflow state of the accrual event.

reason.description: reason provided for the accrual event.

event_type.description: Accrual event category. Current accessible rows show time-off requests.

date_added.description: Date/time the record was added or submitted in the system. Use for request-submission timing.

comments.description: Workflow context field; may include Gone automated approval/denial context.

gone_reason.description: Workflow or supervisor context field. Do not treat as a canonical policy label without inspection.

accrual_event_department_code.description: Department or labor-allocation code selected for the accrual event when present.

employee_code.description: The unique primary identifier associated with the employee across Paycom

clock_sequence.description: An optional employee identifier used for imports and reporting. This is an alphanumeric field that can be up to 15 characters.

employee_gl_code.description: The unique primary identifier associated with General Ledger reporting

badge_number.description: Badge numbers are the numbers that an employee will use when logging in to a kiosk or hardware clock. Badge numbers must be unique. Employees without badge numbers may not be able to interact with kiosks or hardware clocks. Badge numbers are not required for employees to use Web Time Clocks or Web Time Sheets.

employee_name.description: This is the employee's full name in the format of Last Name, First Name Middle Initial

legal_employee_name.description: This is the employees legal full name.

first_name.description: This is the first name of the employee.

middle_name.description: This is the optional middle name of the employee

middle_initial.description: The first letter of the employee's optional middle initial.

last_name.description: This is the last name or family name of the employee.

suffix.description: A suffix in a person's name is a word or letters added to the end of a name to provide additional information about a person's status, background, or profession. Examples of suffixes in names include Jr., Sr., III, and PhD.

nickname.description: This is another accepted name to refer to the employee by. (nickname).

preferred_first_name.description: This is the employees preferred first name, this may be different than the employees legal first name

preferred_middle_name.description: This is the employees preferred middle name, this may be different than the employees legal middle name

preferred_last_name.description: This is the employees preferred last name, this may be different than the employees legal last name

preferred_employee_suffix.description: This is the employees preferred suffix. A suffix in a person's name is a word or letters added to the end of a name to provide additional information about a person's status, background, or profession. Examples of suffixes in names include Jr., Sr., III, and PhD.

employee_status.description: The employee status code indicating whether the employee is Active, Terminated, Inactive, On Leave, Deceased, Retired, Not Hired, or PreHire.

hire_date.description: This is the date the employee was hired in the company.

most_recent_hire_date.description: This is the most recent date the employee was hired, reflective of any rehires

rehire_date.description: This is the employees rehire date if they left the company or were terminated, and then they were hired again.

termination_date.description: This is the date the employee was terminated

old_termination_date.description: This is the date the employee was terminated before they were re-hired.

term_reason.description: This was the 3 character termination reason for why the employee was terminated

seniority_date.description: This is the date of an employees length of service (tenure) for an employee to be considered for PTO Accruals or Benefits eligibility.

leave_absence_start.description: This is the date the employee started Leave of Absence and became Inactive

leave_absence_end.description: This is the date the employee ended Leave of Absence and is no longer Inactive

full_time_to_part_time_date.description: This is the date the employee started working part time from working full time

last_worked_date.description: This is the date that the employee worked last

department_code.description: Employee home Department code. This is the code assigned to the department within company maintenance and is related to labor allocations.

department_name.description: Employee Home Department description. This is the code assigned to the department within company maintenance and is related to labor allocations.

lives_in_state.description: The Lives In state is the state the employee lives in for their assigned tax profile.

works_in_state.description: The Works In state is the state the employee works in for their assigned tax profile.

sui_state.description: The Sui state is the state of their agency for state Unemployment Insurance for their assigned tax profile.

local_tax_1.description: The Local Tax 1 is the 3 character local tax code in the employee's tax profile

date_of_birth.description: This is the date of birth for the employee

marital_status_code.description: This is the marital status code for the employee, values could be S - Single, M - Married, D - Divorced, W - Widowed, or P - Domestic Partner

marital_status_description.description: This is the marital status for the employee, values could be Single, Married, Divorced, Widowed, or Domestic Partner. This could be used for benefits and tax purposes.

gender.description: This is the gender reported by the employee
values: I do not wish to self-identify

ethnic_background.description: This is the ethnic background code reported by the employee

country_code.description: The 2-digit ISO country code associated with the employee's country of residence

street_address_1.description: This is the physical street address the employee enters as their home street address.

street_address_2.description: This is the optional second line the employee enters as their home street address.

city.description: This is the city the employee enters for their home address.

state.description: The state is the state the employee enters for their home address.

zip_code.description: This is the zip code the employee enters as their home address.

work_email.description: This is the email address entered by the employee for communication via email

personal_email.description: This is an email address the employee has for personal uses, it is not a work email managed by the organization

secondary_email.description: This is another email address that can be used for email correspondence with the employee

tertiary_supervisor_ee_code.description: This is the employee code the employee will report to as their tertiary supervisor

quaternary_supervisor_ee_code.description: This is the employee code the employee will report to as their quaternary supervisor

quaternary_supervisor_name.description: This is quaternary supervisor's full name the employee reports to

manager_level_description.description: Displays the description of the manager level, e.g. EXEC : C-Level

position_code.description: A unique alphanumeric code that refers to Position within Position Management

position_level.description: Position Level is an employee's rank or status within a specific position, in which this field displays it as an numeric code to reference for the organization's career structure

position_title_position_info.description: This is the employee's position title from position management.

status_position_info.description: This is the position status of the position the employee is assigned in position management.

business_title_position_info.description: This is the assigned business title of the employee current position from position management.

last_position_change_date.description: This is the most recent date the employee had a position change

union_code.description: The Union code is a unique identifier used to reference which union the employee is apart of, if applicable

eeo1_category.description: The EEO-1 Category classifies jobs into the standardized job categories required for the federal EEO-1 Component 1 Report (Equal Employment Opportunity).

work_location_description.description: This is the work location description of the employee's assigned position.

work_location_address.description: This is the work location street address of the employee's assigned position.

work_location_city.description: This is the work location city of the employee's assigned position.

work_location_state.description: This is the work location state of the employee's assigned position.

work_location_zip.description: This is the work location zip code of the employee's assigned position.

work_location_country.description: This is the work location country of the employee's assigned position.

dol_status_description.description: This is the Department Of Labor status for the employee, whether they are Full Time, Part Time, Temporary, or a Seasonal employee.

employment_type.description: This field indicates whether the employee is a W2 employee or a 1099 employee.

pay_basis.description: This is type of pay the employee receives, some expected values could be Salary, Hourly, Commission, or By Week.

hourly_salary.description: The calculated hourly salary of the employee based on their processing schedule, annual salary, and per pay period hours

annual_salary.description: This is the annual salary of the employee. (Estimated for hourly employee). For a MEDIAN of this column, ClickHouse quantileExact(0.5) returns the UPPER middle value when the group has an even number of rows, not the average of the two middle values; for a true median use (quantileExactLow(0.5)(annual_salary) + quantileExactHigh(0.5)(annual_salary)) / 2.

scheduled_pay_period_hours.description: The Scheduled Pay Period Hours specifies the number of hours the employee works each pay period.

salary_min.description: Salary Min signifies the minimum amount an employee should be paid within a respective range.

salary_mid.description: Salary Mid signifies the mid-point an employee should be paid within a respective range.

salary_max.description: Salary Max signifies the maximum amount an employee should be paid within a respective range.

rate_1.description: This is the base hourly Rate that the employee is paid for most earnings in the system. Usually this is used for regular hours or other earnings that are designated as rate 1 earnings.

employee_pay_type.description: The type of pay the employee gets. It can be one of these 'Comission Only', 'Salary' and 'Hourly'.

position_pay_type.description: The type of pay the this position gets. It can be one of these 'Comission Only', 'Salary' and 'Hourly'.

paycode_profile_code.description: A unique 3 digit alphanumeric code provided by the user that is set when creating a Benefit Eligibility Profile.

paycode_profile_description.description: description or name of the Benefit Eligibility Profile set by the user in addition to the Profile code. The description is a short name that describes the class of employees the profile is set up for.

pay_frequency.description: Schedule indicating how often the employee receives compensation payments.

pay_class.description: A pay class is a set of rules governing how employees earn time and include all rules associated with employee punches, rounding and grace periods. Pay classes are user-specific and set up by Paycom based on the information you provide. This can be found in form 10 of the employee forms.

earning_profile.description: Earning Profile will pull the name of the Earnings Profile that is assigned to an employee. Earning Profiles allow the client specify which earnings will be available for supervisors and employees to add/edit.

schedule_group.description: The Schedule Group represents the schedule the employee is apart of and the shift that are apart of the group.

last_check_date.description: This is the date the employee was paid on last

direct_deposit.description: This is a flag on whether or not the employee uses direct deposit for their pay

dbpcm_warehouse.payroll.description: Payroll register line-item table. Contains paycheck components such as earnings, deductions, taxes, benefits, employer taxes, and net-pay distributions. Not one row per paycheck.
dbpcm_warehouse.payroll.grain_note: Payroll register LINE ITEMS - one row per unique ClickHouse sort/dedup tuple above, not one row per paycheck. transaction_number and check_number should not be treated as unique by themselves. Multiple rows can share the same employee_code + pay_date.

temporal.note: Constrain at least one payroll time dimension before broad aggregation. Use pay_date for issued/paid timing; use pay_period_start_date and pay_period_end_date for the period covered.

dbpcm_warehouse.payroll.primary_key_note: No simple single-column business primary key is exposed. The ORDER BY tuple is unique in observed data and defines the ClickHouse sort/dedup grain.

join_keys.description: Join Payroll to Employee using employee_code.

Each labor_allocation_key_{n} (n=1..20) is a DISTINCT labor-allocation dimension (see each column's own description for what it represents); join the specific key(s) the question needs to labor_allocation on join_key to resolve its code/description.

register_type.description: Main payroll register category for the line item.

amount.description: Monetary amount for the payroll line. Meaning depends on register_type. Negative values can occur for reversals or adjustments.

type_code.description: Payroll code within the register type.

profile_code.description: Payroll profile or benefit eligibility profile code when applicable.

distributed_job_cost_code.description: This is a key formed by concatenating all labor allocation keys.

department_code.description: Department code on the payroll row.

type_rate.description: Rate associated with the type code when applicable.

pay_date.description: Check/payment date; use when the question is about when payroll was issued.

pay_period_start_date.description: Start date of the pay period covered by the line item.

pay_period_end_date.description: End date of the pay period covered by the line item.

transaction_number.description: Payroll transaction reference number. Not unique by itself.

check_number.description: Check number for the payroll item when paid by or associated with a check. Not unique by itself.

dbpcm_warehouse.performance_discussions.description: Performance discussion workflow and form-detail table. Use for writeups, coaching or disciplinary discussions, workflow state, acknowledgments, monitoring periods, uploaded-document filenames, and field-level discussion responses.
dbpcm_warehouse.performance_discussions.grain_note: Field-response-level rows. No reliable row-level natural key is exposed. Use discussion_id for discussion-level grouping (COUNT(DISTINCT discussion_id)); multiple rows exist per discussion_id because field-level responses repeat. Logical analysis grain: one field-response row.
dbpcm_warehouse.performance_discussions.primary_key_note: discussion_id is the discussion-level identifier, but it is not row-unique.

employee_code.description: Employee identifier; canonical join key to employee.

discussion_id.description: Discussion/form/workflow identifier. Group by this for discussion-level analysis.

approval_notes.description: Approval or resolution notes. Sensitive workflow text.

approver.description: User who approved or resolved the discussion.

discussion_notes_updated_by.description: User who last updated discussion notes.

discussion_state.description: Current workflow state of the discussion.

discussion_template.description: Form/template used for the discussion (CLIENT-DEFINED; resolve via resolveValues(discussion_template

document_uploads.description: Uploaded document filenames only; not document contents.

document_uploads_updated_by.description: User who updated uploaded document metadata.

employee_acknowledgment_date.description: Timestamp when employee acknowledged the discussion.

exception_point_threshold.description: Exception-point threshold tier associated with the discussion.

exception_point_total.description: Employee exception-point total at discussion creation time; stored as String. Cast with toFloat64OrNull(exception_point_total) before numeric use — nulls non-numeric values rather than erroring.

field_answer.description: Field-level answer captured on the discussion form. Sensitive form text.

field_completed_by.description: User or employee who completed the field-level answer.

field_description.description: Field-level prompt/description on the discussion form.

last_action_date.description: Timestamp of most recent workflow action.

last_modified_by.description: User who last modified the discussion.

manager_approval_date.description: Timestamp when manager approved or resolved the discussion.

monitoring_period_days.description: Monitoring-period length; stored as String. Cast with toInt32OrNull(monitoring_period_days) before numeric use — nulls non-numeric values rather than erroring.

resolved_date.description: Resolution timestamp when discussion is resolved.

send_back_notes.description: Notes entered when the discussion was sent back. Sensitive workflow text.

dbpcm_warehouse.personnel_action_form_ch.description: Personnel Action Form workflow/change-log table. Each row records one proposed or approved field change within a personnel action transaction; one transaction can contain multiple changed fields.
dbpcm_warehouse.personnel_action_form_ch.grain_note: Logical field-change grain. paf_transaction_id identifies the personnel action transaction, but it is not row-unique because one transaction can span multiple field changes.
dbpcm_warehouse.personnel_action_form_ch.primary_key_note: No reliable row-level primary key is exposed. Use paf_transaction_id for transaction-level grouping, not row uniqueness.

paf_transaction_id.description: Personnel action transaction id. Group by this when analyzing one personnel action rather than individual changed fields.

employee_code.description: Employee identifier for the employee affected by the personnel action.

employee_name.description: Employee display name captured on the PAF row.

paf_effective_date.description: Business-effective date for the proposed or approved change. Can be future dated.

paf_effective_date_time.description: More exact effective timestamp. Use when ordering same-day personnel actions matters.

paf_status.description: Workflow state of the PAF transaction. Not the employee's employment status.

paf_comments.description: Comments associated with the PAF transaction.

forward_to.description: Next approver, recipient, or workflow destination.

modified_by.description: User who last modified the PAF.

created_date.description: Timestamp when the PAF was created or initiated.

modified_date.description: Timestamp when the PAF was last modified.

field_id.description: Identifier for the specific field being changed. CLIENT-DEFINED code space — resolve concepts to field_id sets via resolveValues(field_id, <concept>), never hardcode.

field_label.description: Human-readable label for the field being changed. Use with field_id. CLIENT-DEFINED labels.

old_value.description: Prior value captured by the PAF row.

proposed_value.description: Proposed new value captured by the PAF row.

changed_field_rows.defined_over: rows after temporal, status, employee, and field filters

personnel_actions.defined_over: distinct paf_transaction_id after temporal, status, employee, and field filters
